That being said, I think, that players notice a certain power they have upon intentionally going AFK. They can threaten a team to go AFK, they make people beg to stay – they enjoy to manipulate others and enjoy the feeling of power and control. To me it seems, that actually there has been developing a kind of meta game in solo queue, where people play with each other (ab)using the power to go AFK.

The reason why they can get away with it and still enjoying themselves is, that every teammate gets punished the same as the player going AFK does: He can punish 4 others and present his domination over them by just taking his own elo loss. Since there are legit reasons to be AFK, leavebuster would not punish leavers pretty hard. The real punishment is loss of elo, which hits everybody the same.

In my opinion there ought to be implemented a mechanics, which does not allow one single player to sabotage the game for everybody by going AFK. Rather the leaver should be punished harder, while the other four players should be punished less.

tl;dr: Player who intentionally try to sabotage a game by leaving it and staying AFK are granted too much power. There is need for a system to prevent this trend.
